in_marathi.name: Dhan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dhan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Dhan is a Sanskrit word meaning 'wealth' or 'prosperity'. It is derived from the root word 'dhana', which means 'to hold'. In Hindu culture, Dhan is also associated with the god of wealth, Lord Kubera.
